speaker: Doctor
text: Since your blood gas and D-Dimer are normal, we can rule out severe respiratory failure or pulmonary embolism for now. Given your 20-year smoking history and chronic bronchitis, have you noticed any recent increase in your daily sputum volume or changes in its consistency?
